==Description==
'''Legacy Space City''' is a community [[Maps|map]] which uses the second version of [[Space City]]. Because of this, it cannot be played outside of private servers. It is a futuristic [[Maps|map]] in space.

'''Legacy Space City''' is a two-pathed map, so enemies alternate between the spawn points.

'''Legacy Space City''' has the [[All Paths]] modifier, which duplicates most enemies that spawn.

==Design & Path==
'''Legacy Space City''' takes place in a meteor cluster. Various tall buildings are located on meteors with purple sand. Pipes also link the main meteors together.

The purple path begins at two portals and goes onto several meteors. Metal bridges link the path between meteors. Near the middle of the map, the paths intersect before heading towards the portal at the end of the path.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Space City}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Insane|Modifiers = 1.1|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*The cliff spots are located on the various elevated meteors and buildings scattered across the map.
**While cliff towers can reach the entire map from some meteor spots, it is unlikely that you will be able to reach these towers with a [[Commander]] or [[DJ Booth]].
*Where the paths intersect is where most of your ground towers should be.
**However, space is limited here. If required, you may need to split your team in half.
*Bear in mind that only one unit will spawn per [[Military Base]] or [[Crook Boss]], and it will go down a random path.
*If you plan to use the [[Farm]] intensively, it is recommended that you place it near the end of the map as ground space is very limited on this map.

==Trivia==
*Despite being meant to be the second version of [[Space City]], this is not actually completely accurate as it has the [[All Paths]] modifier, which was not present on the map at the time.
*Despite this map taking place in space, it does not have the [[Space Suit]] modifier.
*This is the only community map which can actually be played in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.
**While other maps do appear as choices, trying to select them will give an error message stating they are invalid maps.
